name: user_activity_count
description: Number of ratings the user made before the cut-off

name: user_distinct_items
description: Distinct items rated

name: user_avg_rating
description: Mean rating given by the user

name: user_rating_std
description: Std-dev of the user's ratings
logic: std(rating) per user, 0 if single rating

name: user_rating_bias
description: How much more generous than average the user is

name: user_share_liked
description: Share of ratings >= relevance threshold

name: user_preferred_genre
description: Genre the user rates most often

name: user_preferred_genre_share
description: Share of ratings in the preferred genre

name: user_genre_entropy
description: Breadth of taste (Shannon entropy of genre profile)

name: user_days_since_last_interaction
description: Recency of the user's last rating

name: user_tenure_days
description: Days between first and last rating

name: user_active_days
description: Number of distinct days with activity

name: user_gender
description: Gender (M/F/U)

name: user_age_group
description: MovieLens age bucket label

name: user_occupation
description: Occupation name

name: genre_profile_{g}
description: Share of the user's ratings that fall in genre {g}
logic: count per genre / total genre tags

name: item_popularity_count
description: Number of ratings the item received

name: item_popularity_rank
description: Rank by popularity (1 = most rated)

name: item_popularity_score
description: Log-scaled popularity in [0, 1]

name: item_avg_rating
description: Mean rating of the item

name: item_bayesian_avg_rating
description: Shrunk mean rating (robust for few ratings)

name: item_rating_std
description: Std-dev of item ratings

name: item_days_since_last_interaction
description: Recency of the item's last rating

name: item_release_year
description: Release year parsed from title

name: item_age_years
description: Item age at the cut-off

name: item_primary_genre
description: First genre (alphabetical) of the item

name: item_num_genres
description: Number of genres tagged

name: genre_{g}
description: One-hot genre indicator

name: rating_deviation_user
description: Rating minus the user's mean rating

name: rating_deviation_item
description: Rating minus the item's mean rating

name: days_before_cutoff
description: Age of the interaction at the cut-off

name: recency_weight
description: Exponential time-decay weight

name: is_liked
description: Implicit positive label

name: user_item_genre_affinity
description: On-demand: how well an item's genres match the user's genre profile
logic: cosine(user genre profile, item genre vector)
